from shop.ages import adult, child_fare, senior
from shop.loyalty import points_for, tier
from shop.tax import tax_band, tax_free


def test_tiers():
    assert [tier(50), tier(400), tier(1500)] == ['bronze', 'silver', 'gold']


def test_points():
    assert points_for(10, True) == 20 and points_for(10, False) == 10


def test_tax_bands():
    assert [tax_band(10000), tax_band(30000), tax_band(90000)] == [0, 1, 2]


def test_tax_free_students():
    assert tax_free(14000, True) and not tax_free(14000, False)


def test_ages():
    assert adult(18) and not adult(17) and senior(70) and child_fare(8)
